errors: loop/gate.py:175 Check-failure text includes the unique run log path, so the signature at line 198 changes every attempt and the same failing check stays repair forever. The locked test only repeats a stable reviewer finding, so it never proves the checks-stage stop rule.

loop/__main__.py:48 mark pr_open has no gate check, and mark merged treats pr_open as sufficient without comparing HEAD to passed_head, so a merge can be recorded for a task that never passed the gate or for a later commit.

loop/gate.py:99 The .loop/ exemption matches the raw porcelain line. A rename is recorded as 'R  .loop/<old> -> <new>', so a rename onto an allowed path skips the clean check; scope keeps only the destination, tests run on the dirty tree, and passed_head remains HEAD.

blocking.issue: Check-failure text includes the unique run log path, so the signature at line 198 changes every attempt and the same failing check stays repair forever. The locked test only repeats a stable reviewer finding, so it never proves the checks-stage stop rule.

mark pr_open has no gate check, and mark merged treats pr_open as sufficient without comparing HEAD to passed_head, so a merge can be recorded for a task that never passed the gate or for a later commit.

The .loop/ exemption matches the raw porcelain line. A rename is recorded as 'R  .loop/<old> -> <new>', so a rename onto an allowed path skips the clean check; scope keeps only the destination, tests run on the dirty tree, and passed_head remains HEAD.

suggestions: Do not clear failures or keep a stale passed_head when loop spec rewrites an identical hash.
Treat non-dict blocking entries as a malformed verdict so gate() records fail instead of raising AttributeError before writing state.
Parse git diff -z and status -z, and apply the .loop exemption to every path in a rename, not to the raw line or to whitespace-split tokens.
Re-run the clean check after run_checks, and include the check commands in the spec lock.
Reject reviewer --mode unless the value is ask, even when --mode is already in argv.
Write into the T1 goal that cash is in the weight denominator and in no industry, as in rules.cash_in_denominator.
